citations.title: Microsoft’s trillion-dollar quarter powered by ravenous AI trade

key_themes: Azure growth above guidance and demand across both traditional and AI workloads could support continued cloud growth.
Strong commercial bookings and an 84% increase in remaining performance obligations indicate a substantial pipeline of contracted demand, though conversion and margins remain relevant.
The wide-moat assessment and strong operating margin suggest durable competitive advantages and operating strength, if sustained.
market_insights: Microsoft reported fiscal Q4 revenue of $90.0 billion, up 17% year over year in constant currency, and an operating margin of 45.1%; both exceeded the cited guidance benchmarks.
Azure growth was 43% in constant currency versus guidance of 39.5%, with strength in traditional and AI workloads. The article also says Azure remains capacity-constrained.
Capital expenditure grew 110%, highlighting the substantial investment required to meet demand and the possibility that spending may weigh on cash flow or returns if growth disappoints.
